segments.text: In this video, you'll learn general methods and strategies for minimizing risk when using

segments.text: chemicals and lab equipment. Minimizing risk is part of a larger process called RAMP.

segments.text: RAMP stands for Recognize Hazards, Assess Risks, Minimize Risks, and Prepare for Emergencies.
segments.zh: RAMP 代表：识别危害、评估风险、最小化风险、为紧急情况做准备。

segments.text: For this video, we'll assume you've already completed the first two steps of RAMP,

segments.text: you could be exposed to chemicals in the lab. There are four ways chemicals can enter your body.
segments.zh: 你在实验室里可能通过哪些方式接触到化学品。化学品进入人体有四种途径。

segments.text: The first is inhalation, the most common route of exposure. Some chemicals are used in gas form,
segments.zh: 第一种是吸入，这是最常见的暴露途径。有些化学品以气体形式使用，

segments.text: which makes it easy to accidentally inhale them. But many liquid chemicals also produce a vapor.
segments.zh: 这使人很容易不小心吸入。但许多液体化学品也会产生蒸气。

segments.text: Some solids even give off fumes. Anytime you smell a chemical, you are inhaling the gas,

segments.text: but you might not smell all gases. Some have no odor, while others may be too dilute to smell,

segments.text: but still cause harm. The second most common route of exposure is direct contact with the

segments.zh: 最佳方式。如果没有危害，显然就没有风险。如果我们不能完全
